itens.trecho: Engraçado, mas a construção das personagens deixa a desejar. Este filme conta a história de um grupo de animais do Zoo do Central Park que arranja uma maneira de voltar à África.

"Alex" the lion is quite literally king of the castle at the Central Park zoo in New York. He even has his own, built in, tanning machine. His pals, though - well they are not so enamoured of the place.
